node.title: DLI ell=2 weight-6 relations reduce to a guarded triple-cubic norm router
node.statement: Assume the paid official order-1024 weight-3 exclusion. Normalize three roots of a reduced weight-6 relation to {1,x,y}, put u=1+x+y, A=x+y+xy, B=xy, and select the product d in mu_1024 of the remaining triple. Then u is nonzero, C=(uA-B-d)/u, and the remaining roots have cubic T^3+uT^2+CT-d. Scaling those roots by u gives division-free coupled doubling recurrences S_(2m)=S_m^2-2T_m, T_(2m)=T_m^2-2P_mS_m, P_(2m)=P_m^2. Subject to the exact distinctness/disjointness guards, the cubic roots lie in mu_1024 iff S_1024=3u^1024 and T_1024=3u^2048. Thus the residual (ell,w)=(2,6) slot reduces to at most 1,514*1,024=1,550,336 pair-product candidates, each with two explicit cyclotomic norm obstructions. An official supporting prime cannot divide Norm(u), by the weight-3 exclusion, so all shared Norm(u) factors may be saturated out of the norm gcd. This is a proved router, not an emptiness theorem.
